title: architectureProposals survives project switch / PRD open; project A cards can seed project B decision
notes: Partially fixed — remaining part per 2026-09-29 re-check: e6d1c576 adds setArchitectureProposals(null) to the currentProjectId reset effect (useProductShellController.ts:179-180) and to handleOpenPrdAuthoring (:702). The finding's second path remains: the .then of plan.submitPrdInterviewTurn (:752-760) sets result.architectureProposals without checking currentProjectId or the request generation. A turn that resolves after a project switch still surfaces project A's stack cards on B's PRD board, which renders them as clickable student_confirmed stack cards (PrdAuthoringBoard.tsx:474, :650).
repro: Submit a PRD interview turn on project A, switch to project B before the LLM resolves, then open PRD authoring on B: A's stack proposal cards appear
